items.title: Saudis pivot to send more oil through Strait of Hormuz
items.title_zh: 东西向管线停运后，沙特转向霍尔木兹外船对船售亚约2000万桶
items.summary_zh: TT/彭博：阿美向亚洲炼厂出售约2000万桶现货，9–10月在霍尔木兹外侧阿曼湾船对船提货——原油仍须穿峡，但买方不承担峡内航段。信号是红海出口受限后，利雅得被迫把传统海湾通道重新抬上台面；阿美已推迟部分延布对欧交付，且未公布管线复运时间表。

quotes.author: Bloomberg via TT News
quotes.en: The rising spot sales via the Persian Gulf suggest that Riyadh is now seeking to pivot back toward its traditional route even as risks to shipping persist.
quotes.zh: 经波斯湾现货销售上升，表明利雅得即便航运风险仍在，也在寻求转回传统出口通道。

items.title: Cyclomatic Complexity in C#
items.summary_zh: NDepend 博客梳理圈复杂度在现代语言里的误用：路径数多确实难读，但“拆函数”未必是唯一解；有人指出对模式匹配等语法，指标会虚高。

quotes.author: bunderbunder
quotes.en: Overall cyclomatic complexity is a useful metric, but it does have one shortcoming when used with modern languages: it was invented before polymorphism really became a thing. That means that it really only counts explicit branching. So, for example, in an OO language like C#, calling a virtual method doesn’t increment cyclomatic complexity even though the method invocation could go down many code paths. Potentially thousands if you’re dealing with a common interface like IEnumerable. If you’re working on a library then the number of potential code paths in this kind of situation is unbounded. As an aside, it’s interesting to think how it might apply to a language like Smalltalk that doesn’t even have if or switch statements. OO isn’t the only monkey wrench, either. Higher-order functions a
quotes.zh: 总体来说圈复杂度是有用指标，但用在现代语言上有个短板：它对某些新语法会虚高。

quotes.author: Deukhoofd
quotes.en: I don't disagree that functions with many execution paths are harder to read, but I do believe that the solution given here; 'just split it into multiple functions' frequently makes a function even harder to read. It forces you to scroll back and forth between code. I think generally when you run into something like this, the better way to handle it is to sit back, and reconsider how your overall handling is designed.
quotes.zh: 我不否认执行路径很多的函数更难读，但我觉得文中给出的‘拆函数’解法并不是唯一答案。

items.title: Pipeline Attacks Expose Limits of Saudi Export Flexibility
items.title_zh: 管线遇袭暴露沙特出口弹性上限：三线受敌与MEES称9月上半月出口回升
items.summary_zh: 阿拉伯湾国家研究所长文：东西向管线三座泵站受损后，沙特同时面对东侧伊朗、北侧伊拉克民兵与南侧胡塞；8月产量报OPEC约624万桶/日为1990年来最低。MEES称9月上半月中东出口均量约1620万桶/日、为开战以来最高之一，卫星影像显示11号泵站抢修；长期选项如重启Tapline或新建至阿曼管线都以年计。

quotes.author: Kate Dourian / AGSI
quotes.en: With both its eastern and western export routes now compromised, Saudi Arabia is running out of options to get its oil to market.
quotes.zh: 东西两条出口通道如今都受损，沙特正逐渐耗尽把石油送向市场的选项。

items.title: An open source roguelike adventure through dungeons
items.title_zh: 开源地牢肉鸽冒险：Dungeon Crawl
items.summary_zh: 经典开源肉鸽 Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup 再次现身首页；老玩家感慨版本迭代快到“拾起时已不是当年爱上的那款”，也有人单纯为持续维护点赞。

quotes.author: vintermann
quotes.en: This is one of the first games which changed so much that I picked it up again and realized it's not the game I liked anymore. It may still be a fine game, but it has little association to Linley Henzell's Crawl left. These days, as more non-open games go into "updates forever" mode, it's probably going to happen more. I can see it happening real time with Minecraft.
quotes.zh: 这是最早让我重玩时发现‘已经不是我喜欢的那款游戏’的作品之一——改得太快了。

quotes.author: Founderarcstone
quotes.en: love seeing this kind of work great job!
quotes.zh: 喜欢看到这类工作，干得漂亮！

items.title: Houthis Target Riyadh for First Time in Latest Escalation as US Avoids Offensive Strikes

items.title: Goroutine Leak Profiles
items.summary_zh: Go 官方博客介绍 goroutine 泄漏画像，帮助定位“开了协程却忘了收尾”的故障；评论总结经验法则：不理解如何结束，就不要 go。

quotes.author: deathanatos
quotes.en: I'm coming predominately from other languages, so it took me a hot minute to figure out what the various bug were. • channels are by default "unbuffered", in that a send needs a waiting recv to actually do the send, and blocks until such. The addition of the buffer prevents the block & permits the goroutine to progress (and eventually exit, and thus, not leak) … so long as the buffer is sufficiently large enough. • channels do not, AFAICT, realize when the receiver is gone, and will block indefinitely even when there is no receiver. (It is the same "chan" object, I think, in both sender/receiver / there is no distinction. So, the single object is never GC'd.) • goroutines are not GC'd. (& the code doesn't/can't hold like, a reference or a handle to a goroutine / there is no "join" primitiv
quotes.zh: 我主要来自别的语言，花了好一会儿才搞清各种坑：通道没关、等待条件永远不成立之类。

quotes.author: sethammons
quotes.en: General rule: never call a goroutine without understanding how it will close.
quotes.zh: 一般规则：搞不清它怎么结束，就永远不要开 goroutine。

items.title: Do birds have accents? the regional differences in birdsong
items.title_zh: 鸟有口音吗？鸟鸣的地域差异
items.summary_zh: The Conversation 介绍鸟鸣方言与文化传递；有人补充某些鸣声甚至带遗传成分，也有人安利观鸟 App 的上瘾体验。

quotes.author: dkga
quotes.en: Beautiful. An interesting tidbit some here may like: for some birds, their songs carry over genetically. As a result, there are no dialects in the same sense as described in this page. The most famous example (at least in the Americas) is Pitangus sulphuratus (known in Brazil as "bem-te-vi"). This bird is present from Southern US until Southern Argentina, and has virtually the same song all over. In fact, I know I arrived in Brazil when I get out of the airport, anyone in the country, and catch a (sometimes clear, sometimes faint) "bem-te-vi, bem-te-vi" song.
quotes.zh: 很美。有个这里人可能会喜欢的冷知识：对某些鸟，鸣声会遗传传递，结果方言并不全是‘学来的’。

quotes.en: I've been birdspotting for the last year (in the UK, there is an addictive app called birdex, which is basically like a pokedex in the pokemon game, except it does birds). I am proud to report that I've observed 110 species this year. The last one was this weekend, where apparently meadow pipits are traveling across London parks while they're heading south. It's not just regional dialects and individual birds, I am noticing that the time of the year also matters. Tits sound different in spring, summer and autumn, and so do e.g. robins. It's a hobby I can recommend to everyone. Whenever I am outside now, I can listen for any faint sound and then make a mental note of all the birds I observed.
quotes.zh: 我过去一年在观鸟（英国有个叫 birdex 的 App，基本像上瘾的收集游戏）。
